tagline: Your 24/7 AI Marketing Team: Plan, Schedule, Create, Analyze Your Content, Ads, GEO/SEO & Social!
description: The fastest-growing teams aren’t working harder—they’re delegating to AI. Our marketing agents tap into HubSpot, Salesforce, WordPress, Notion, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Reddit, X, and more, powered by OpenAI and Gemini. In minutes, you can automate the repetitive blog, ad, GEO/SEO, and social tasks that steal your time, and turn your marketing into a machine that never gets tired. From researching and commenting on Reddit, to posting on LinkedIn, to writing blog posts and creating videos, our AI agents are your new marketing team that works 24/7 to grow your business.
meta_description: Empower your business with AI-Native Marketing Agents! Automate tasks, boost productivity, and achieve more with intelligent AI working for you.
assistant_squad_description: The Assistant Squad is an all-in-one assistant that sends emails or book meetings using Outlook, Gmail, and Google Calendar. It can search and browse the internet, search for news, and generate a research summary.
image_creator_squad_description: The Image Squad lets you generate a wide variety of images and drawings from simple text prompts in multiple ratios and formats such as WEBP, JPEG, PNG, 16:9, 1:1, 9:16 using the ImageGen4 model from Google.
video_squad_description: The Video Squad transforms text prompts into captivating videos with voice-over and titles as needed, it creates transcripts of your videos, it can assemble multiple videos together, and upload them to YouTube directly for you.
copywriting_squad_description: The Copywriting Squad can browse the internet, create articles and upload them to Notion or Google Docs, create GEO/SEO-friendly blog articles and generate an image for it and then upload the blog to WordPress, all tailored to your brand.
presentation_squad_description: The Presentation Squad can browse the internet, generate images and text for each slide and finally create a downloadable PowerPoint slideshow to continue editing it locally as needed.
social_media_squad_description: The Social Squad generates social post content and post them directly to multiple social networks including Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn and Reddit after your approval. It can search Reddit for posts and comment on them after getting your approval.
seo_expert_squad_description: The GEO/SEO Squad analyzes web pages and finds GEO/SEO improvements that scores 100% on YoastSEO and All-In-One SEO. It uses Google Keyword Planner for keyword research and provides volumes, competition score and CPC.
campaign_planner_squad_description: The Planner Squad can craft detailed marketing strategies using deep market analysis and insights. It can generate comprehensive plans, budgets, and timelines to ensure your campaigns are effective and on budget.
digital_ads_squad_description: The Ads Squad can streamlines ad creation across platforms with precise character limits and compliant formats, ensuring your campaigns are optimized for success. It generates Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads and more.
coders_squad_description: The Coders Squad can help you develop, test, and optimize code across multiple programming languages such as python, javascript, css, html, and much more. It can also write SQL queries, develop HTML templates, and even create shell scripts.
data_scientist_squad_description: The Data Squad can consolidate your marketing data analysis into actionable charts and reports. It can analyze any type of data, connect to Google Analytics and Google Sheets, and generate insightful charts and graphs.
lead_generation_squad_description: The Lead Squad can research and build targeted prospect lists to drive your marketing efforts. It can generate lists of potential clients, contacts for ABM campaigns, and even provide detailed information about companies in specific industries.
our_squads:
Our Squads

Promarkia is powered by a suite of AI agents squads, each designed to tackle specific marketing tasks. From content creation to data analysis, our squads work together to streamline your marketing efforts.
subtitle: AI Assisted Marketing automation for SaaS, E-commerce, Agencies and more!

testimonial_quote_2: We replaced a messy stack of writing tools, schedulers, and spreadsheets with one workflow. One brief now turns into blog, social, ads, and follow-up.
testimonial_quote_3: As a founder-led team, we needed execution more than another dashboard. Promarkia handles the repetitive marketing work so we can focus on customers.
integrations_text:
Promarkia delivers an all-in-one integration ecosystem that plugs directly into Google Workspace with Calendar, Gmail, Sheets, Docs, Drive, Analytics and Ads, as well as Microsoft tools like Outlook and Teams. Seamlessly sync and automate lead workflows in HubSpot and Salesforce, or manage tasks in Wrike.

Feed your GEO/SEO engine with real-time data from Ahrefs and SEMrush, publish to social networks including Facebook, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Reddit and Discord. Upload complete blog posts with images and content directly to WordPress. With every tool connected under one roof, you can orchestrate truly unified, cross-channel marketing campaigns without ever leaving the platform.

From the moment I started using it, I was struck by its intuitive design and powerful features that helped me save hours on routine tasks. If you’re looking for a hassle-free way to get more done in less time, this is the solution you’ve been waiting for. Highly recommended!

The platform is packed with powerful features that streamline our campaigns, from content creation to analytics, while remaining incredibly user-friendly. Our entire team was able to dive right in with minimal training, saving us both time and resources.
testimonial_3: From the moment I reached out until the final result, every aspect of the process was exceptional. The team went above and beyond to ensure I was fully satisfied, and their attention to detail truly impressed me. An outstanding experience from start to finish, I’ll definitely be coming back for more!
email_marketing_squad_description: The Email Marketing Squad plans and writes email campaigns, nurture sequences, newsletters, drip campaigns, and A/B subject line variants. It can send via Gmail or Outlook after your approval.
analytics_squad_description: The Analytics Squad collects data from Google Analytics, Sheets, and CSV files, analyzes trends and KPIs, and produces polished executive reports with actionable recommendations.
competitor_intelligence_squad_descriptio: The Competitor Intelligence Squad scans competitor websites, analyzes pricing, features, and positioning, and produces SWOT analyses, feature comparison matrices, and strategic recommendations.
brand_guidelines_squad_description: The Brand Guidelines Squad audits your content against brand standards, checks tone, voice, and terminology compliance, and rewrites non-compliant content to match your brand guidelines.
